summary: 16-fixed-window id space of the in-game window manager (winmgr). Every id's object base, ctors, vtable, paint, register rect, GameInter.wil frame and click handler are bound by primary-static disassembly. ids 5/10 have no window object; id 15 is the banner/notice (display-only, never hit-testable); there is NO friends/social window id (documented negative, consistent with Finding 270).

winmgr.basis: gameObj 0x47EF18 + 0x2A548C (confirmed by boot call 0x418C41: lea ecx,[esi+0x2a548c]; call 0x426C10 and by toggle callers 0x4214EB/0x42151A: lea ecx,[ebx+0x2a548c] with ebx=0x47EF18)

window_object_layout.first_dword: class/vtable pointer (installed by pre-ctor, e.g. 0x42679D mov [esi],0x476624)
window_object_layout.+0x18/+0x1C: current x / y (hit-test rect origin; register rect x/y)
window_object_layout.+0x30: active/visible flag - set by vtable+0x10 = 0x423F80: mov [ecx+0x30],arg;ret 4
window_object_layout.+0x34: enable flag - set by 0x423F90: mov [ecx+0x34],arg;ret 4 (used by close-all 0x42B870+)
window_object_layout.+0x40/+0x44: geometry w / h (base ctor computes from rect or args)

input_loop.id_to_slot_formula: slot = winmgr + ((id*5 + 0x267) * 9) * 4 = winmgr + 0x567C + id*0xB4 (verified @0x42BF06-0x42BF12; counter 0..0xF at [esp+0x14])
input_loop.per_caption_call: mov eax,[slot]; lea ecx,[slot]; call [eax+0x10] = caption vtable+0x10 = 0x4177F0 (release/click-test: PtInRect 0x4762B4 against [obj+4], plays sound 0x45AFC0(0x8AB130,0x69), returns 1 on click)
input_loop.window_click_entry: 0x42BF70: cmp edi,-1; je 0x42BEF8; cmp edi,0xE; ja 0x42C198; jmp [edi*4 + 0x42C4D4]  (ids 0..0xE only; id 0xF unreachable)
input_loop.hit_test: 0x42AAB0 walks visible list; per-node id [node+0]; guard id>0xE -> skip (0x42AB8A PtInRect path); rect stub table 0x42ABE8 loads rect {+0x18,+0x1C,+0x20,+0x24} at winmgr+off

layout.+0x0C: 0x423D00 generic frame render (active windows only; frame + owner text at +8/+0xC)

window_class_vtables.install_site: each window pre-ctor (called from winmgr ctor 0x426C10) stores 0x476624 then overwrites [obj+0] with the derived vtable (restored to base only inside dtor); derived vtables all share +0x0C=0x423D00 and +0x10=0x423F80 EXCEPT npc 0x476938 (+0x0C=0x43F040, +0x10=0x43F020) and quest 0x476A54 (+0x10=0x4488B0)
